description: J.L.B. Kothelawala and Two Others v Daya Ranjith Senanayake J.L.B. Kothelawala and Two Others v Daya Ranjith Senanayake View More before Hon. W.L. Ranjith Silva, J.
parties: J.L.B. Kothelawala and Two Others v Daya Ranjith Senanayake J.L.B. Kothelawala and Two Others v Daya Ranjith Senanayake View More
keywords: Revision application against the High Court of Colombo order where the learned High Court Judge held that the Petitioners were not entitled to be heard prior to reaching a decision to a complain to the Magistrate\'s Court in terms of Section 135-136(1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act for giving false evidence. Held - restrictive interpretation of Section 135(1)(c) is unwarranted; Section 63 casts no duty on the judge to hear accussed prior to the issue. Application dismissed without costs.
legistation: Section 265 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 read with Article 138(1) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
